title: 4v4 Must-Pass-Middle Game
description: A half-court 4v4 where the ball must touch a player in the middle of the floor before any shot attempt, forcing teams to play inside-out.

content.objective: Learn to play inside-out by requiring the ball to touch the middle of the floor before shooting.
content.setup: Four offensive players face four defenders in a half-court game with a constraint rule in place.
instructions: Play live 4v4 to a target score.
Before any shot attempt, the ball must touch a player positioned in the middle of the floor (elbow or post).
If the rule is violated, the possession ends in a turnover regardless of the shot's result.
Rotate teams after every five possessions.
coachingPoints: Look to touch the middle early in the possession, not as an afterthought.
The middle player should look to score or kick back out quickly, not hold the ball.
Keep good spacing so the middle pass is actually available.
commonMistakes: Forcing a quick shot and forgetting the middle-touch constraint entirely.
The middle player holding the ball too long once they receive it.
Ignoring the game's constraint once the pressure is on.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
